 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Fill one-cell horizontal gaps between repeated markers with color 2."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if not grid:
        return out
    from collections import Counter
    flat = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    background = Counter(flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            if (row[c] == background and row[c - 1] != background
                    and row[c - 1] == row[c + 1]):
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
